learning_outcomes.text: Represent physical problems in a form suitable for numerical solution
Apply numerical integration and differentiation with error awareness
Solve ordinary differential equations numerically and assess stability
Use Monte Carlo methods for sampling and estimation
Validate and visualise simulation results against known limits
Reason about floating-point error, convergence and reproducibility

integrative_case: A graduate student builds a simulation of a damped driven oscillator: choose a time-step and integrator, check energy behaviour for stability, validate against the known analytic solution in a limit, and report the numerical error honestly.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
